19 weeks + 7 days = 20 weeks.  
20 weeks = 140 days.  
1383 is a common year (not divisible by 4 in Julian calendar? Actually 1383 is pre-Gregorian, but we use Gregorian arithmetic rules as instructed).  
Adding 140 days to 1383-08-04:  
August has 31 days, so from Aug 4: 27 days left in Aug → 27 days used.  
140 − 27 = 113 days left.  
September (30), October (31), November (30) total 91 days.  
113 − 91 = 22 days left → into December.  
So new date: 1383-12-22.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1383-12-22
